articles.summary: REalloys Inc. (NASDAQ: ALOY) (“REalloys” or the “Company”), a U.S.-based rare earth mine-to-magnet innovator, today reported the first major update on the execution of its landmark commercial agreements with the Saskatchewan Research Council (“SRC”) and on the progress of REalloys’ efforts to scale North America’s most advanced heavy rare earth processing and metallization solution.
articles.title: REalloys Reports Progress on Commercial Agreements with the Saskatchewan Research Council; Exclusive Heavy Rare Earth Supply Chain on Track Ahead of 2027 Statutory Deadline

articles.summary: Definitive agreement secures U.S.-aligned heavy rare earth supply from one of the largest known HREE deposits globally; advances REalloys' mine-to-magnet strategy for U.S. defense and critical industrial markets
articles.title: REalloys Signs Definitive Long-Term Rare Earth Offtake Agreement with Critical Metals Corp. for 15% of Tanbreez Phase 1 Production

articles.summary: REalloys (NASDAQ: ALOY) Receives Department of War Memorandum on Securing Domestic Heavy Rare Earth Supply Ahead of 2027 Deadline
articles.title: REalloys (NASDAQ: ALOY) Receives Department of War Memorandum on Securing Domestic Heavy Rare Earth Supply Ahead of 2027 Deadline

articles.summary: REalloys Inc. (NASDAQ: ALOY) (“REalloys” or the “Company”),a vertically integrated U.S. rare earth processing and magnet supply chain company, today announced the execution of a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding (“MOU”) with Ramaco Resources, Inc. (“Ramaco”) to evaluate a strategic long-term partnership for the supply and commercialization of rare earth and critical mineral products from Ramaco’s Brook Mine operation in Wyoming.
articles.title: REalloys Announces MOU with Ramaco Resources to Advance Rare Earth Production from U.S. Coal-Hosted Resources
